segment_contamination_dimensions: Brand-specific portable toilet buyers (Sintex brand segment) — 'Sintex Portable Toilets' is a live sibling MCAT; names or alt_names referencing the Sintex brand have been excluded to avoid attracting buyers searching specifically for Sintex-branded units rather than generic bunk house cabin units

FRP modular toilet buyers (generic FRP modular segment) — 'FRP Modular Toilet' and 'FRP Portable Toilet' are live sibling MCATs; names that would be indistinguishable from those categories (e.g., plain 'FRP Modular Toilet' or 'FRP Portable Toilet' without the bunk house / labour camp qualifier) have been excluded
MS portable toilet buyers (generic MS segment) — 'MS Portable Toilets' is a live sibling MCAT; names using only 'MS Portable Toilet' without the bunk house / worker camp qualifier have been excluded

Mobile toilet van and mobile toilet buyers — 'Mobile Toilet Van' and 'Mobile Toilets' are live sibling MCATs covering vehicle-mounted or wheeled mobile units; names implying vehicle-mounted mobility (van, truck-mounted, towed trailer unit as primary descriptor) have been excluded

Bio toilet buyers — 'Bio Toilet' is a live sibling MCAT; bio-digester or bio toilet as a standalone descriptor has been excluded from enhanced names, though bio-digester remains a valid product_type variant within this MCAT
